description: Opus DD unit B26: Toxic Spikes (one layer, patched) on p2's side. Mold Breaker Excadrill Roars Snorlax out and Tauros is dragged in next to Pastel Veil Ponyta-Galar while the Roar is still active. Tauros (faster) runs the hazard first: Pastel Veil's `onAllySetStatus` is skipped (breakable, `suppressingAbility`), so Tauros is poisoned; then Pastel Veil's `onAnySwitchIn`, run in the same SwitchIn event, is skipped by `singleEvent` too, so Tauros stays poisoned and takes its poison damage at the residual.
